name: systemd-timer-persistence
description: Practice-box persistence finding: installs a systemd .timer plus its companion .service and enables+starts the timer -- the timer-based persistence pattern. Vars: TIMER_NAME (required, no .timer suffix), EXEC_START (required), DESCRIPTION (optional), ON_BOOT_SEC (optional, default 2min), ON_UNIT_ACTIVE_SEC (optional, default 15min), PERSISTENT (optional, 1 adds Persistent=true), PAYLOAD_PATH + PAYLOAD_BODY (optional).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu


: "${TIMER_NAME:?TIMER_NAME is required (no .timer suffix)}"
: "${EXEC_START:?EXEC_START is required}"

if [ -n "${PAYLOAD_PATH-}" ]; then
    install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname -- "$PAYLOAD_PATH")"
    printf '#!/bin/sh\n%s\n' "${PAYLOAD_BODY-}" > "$PAYLOAD_PATH"
    chmod 0755 "$PAYLOAD_PATH"
fi

{
    printf '%s\n' '[Unit]'
    printf 'Description=%s\n' "${DESCRIPTION:-Scheduled task}"
    printf '\n%s\n' '[Service]'
    printf '%s\n' 'Type=oneshot'
    printf 'ExecStart=%s\n' "$EXEC_START"
} > "/etc/systemd/system/${TIMER_NAME}.service"

{
    printf '%s\n' '[Unit]'
    printf 'Description=%s\n' "${DESCRIPTION:-Scheduled task timer}"
    printf '\n%s\n' '[Timer]'
    printf 'OnBootSec=%s\n' "${ON_BOOT_SEC:-2min}"
    printf 'OnUnitActiveSec=%s\n' "${ON_UNIT_ACTIVE_SEC:-15min}"
    if [ "${PERSISTENT:-0}" = "1" ]; then
        printf '%s\n' 'Persistent=true'
    fi
    printf '\n%s\n' '[Install]'
    printf '%s\n' 'WantedBy=timers.target'
} > "/etc/systemd/system/${TIMER_NAME}.timer"

chmod 0644 "/etc/systemd/system/${TIMER_NAME}.service" \
           "/etc/systemd/system/${TIMER_NAME}.timer"

if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    systemctl daemon-reload
    systemctl enable --now "${TIMER_NAME}.timer"
fi
